rapport_notes: Rep is professional and efficient but somewhat mechanical; minimal warmth or personality, heavy on logistics.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'does that make sense?' after the pricing explanation but did not hold silence for a response before continuing. Rep did not ask 'does that feel fair?' after the estimate explanation and did not ask an explicit close ask ('would you like our help with your move?').

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let's start with a few questions. To get you on track. This should take about ten minutes. Then we'll be able to build you an estimate you can depend on.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: do you have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to discuss during this call? [asked after collecting name, phone, email, address, and other logistics]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern: 'usually when I get a U-Haul I get like a blanket or two to just wrap that up' (fragile glass item). Rep acknowledged ('Okay, no worries.') but did not follow with 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is fragile?' — pivoted immediately to box count. No second layer probing on any concern.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: we will provide up to $2,000 per move that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items. [delivered in Stage 2 pricing explanation, no damage concern was raised in Stage 1]
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: a few days before you move we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are. [delivered in Stage 2 pricing explanation]
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill. [delivered in Stage 2 pricing explanation]
evidence_quotes.communication: we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are... and the confirmation email... will also give you a brief overview of how our communication will work leading up to IMMU. [delivered in Stage 2 pricing explanation and closing confirmation]
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: a typical one bedroom apartment would normally takes two movers that is between two and a half to three and a half hours to completely move... In your case... estimated time is between two and a half to three and a half hours estimated cost is from $575.05 to $805.
evidence_quotes.window_logic: the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there... So in case if you have extra time to prepare like you have mentioned but in the small items interior boxes yourself that would really help to keep the time down.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: for any move we have a minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: we are efficient when we are moving big boxes and big furniture. But we'll do some of our efficiency when you get down to small selan items. So in case if you have extra time to prepare... that would really help to keep the time down.
evidence_quotes.close: I'll also send you confirmation email... Do you have any other questions for me by any chance? [No rate-lock statement. No explicit ask such as 'would you like our help with your move?']

top_strength: Rep delivered a complete and clear pricing overview with all major differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, communication, no hidden fees, proration) in one coherent block, making the value proposition easy for the customer to understand.
coaching_note: Rep asked 'any specific concerns?' but only after collecting five minutes of logistics, and when the customer did raise a fragile-item concern, the rep acknowledged it but never dug deeper with a follow-up question — shift the agenda question to the top of discovery, and always ask 'tell me more about that' or 'what else?' at least once per concern raised.
